newsitem.title: UK: JIB forecasts growth in Asia Pacific.
newsitem.headline: JIB forecasts growth in Asia Pacific.

text.p: UK insurance broker JIB Group Plc said on Monday it expects to expand its business over the next six months in key overseas markets, despite competitive pressures continuing.
"Growth...can be obtained in developing markets, particularly in the Asia Pacific region where JIB is well established," the company said in a statement with its first half results.

"In addition speciality markets offer good prospects, provided that the insurance adviser can demonstrate real added value," the company said after announcing a 28 percent jump in pre-tax profits to 16.4 million stg.
"We have experienced a high level of new business in these areas and are confident that JIB will continue to perform well in the second half of 1996."
Like other brokers and insurers, JIB said it was experiencing particularly soft rating conditions in the marine market.
However, it said it had performed strongly elsewhere, particularly in reinsurance, where it had won "a considerable volume of business in the UK and United States."
The outlook for Lloyd's of London was much improved now that the insurance market has secured more than 90 percent support from its backers for its Reconstruction and Renewal plan, the broker said.
"Much still needs to be done to improve the market's efficiency and to restore its full reputation. Nevertheless, the clearing of this major hurdle augurs well for the future."
JIB said its contribution to Lloyd's 3.2 billion stg rescue package was covered by existing reserves.
